name: dobe_drink8b
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind squeezing someone in a very tight hug, both arms clamped hard around them pulling them against its chest, its pursed muzzle pressed flat onto their face, mouth hidden on the far side and never visible, no teeth, no eye visible. The arms keep squeezing with small tightening pulses, only its head and neck bob very slightly by one or two pixels like slow steady gulps, lower body stays still on the pillar, sticky goo oozing from the muzzle tip, very subtle motion, looping
